turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
That's a machine's guess, and the companies that sell these tools say outright they shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure says the same thing. I asked who decided.
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm walking to the principal's office when I leave here anyway. I'll want that referral in writing. Now, who decided?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow is fine, I'm going today. You've threatened me twice and still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that you tell me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on whether Owen was heard before the mark went in, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended long before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document in front of her that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You led with the checker score, which she treats as a machine's guess that even the vendors say cannot stand alone, and then you threatened the office twice instead of answering her question.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed no times, dates or documents at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided and why Owen learned about the zero on his phone, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work she can check.
